scene.major.means: Which part of the game is up. It changes as a mode starts, before the mode's movie.

values.2: the opening movie and the title

scene.minor.means: Which screen is up. A course or the city loads between two frames the link sends, so loading has no screen of its own.

values.0: the opening movie and the title
values.16: City Trial's machine stats after the clock
values.17: the card that names the stadium
values.18: an Air Ride race (air-ride-courses-1.txt 3200), the city or a stadium

menu.page.means: Which page of the main menu is up.

menu.mode.means: The mode the main menu's cursor is on.

menu.item.means: The row the cursor is on in a mode's own menu, from 0 at the top.

course_select.cursor.means: The course Air Ride's course select has the cursor on, five to a row from the top left.

settings.row.means: The row the cursor is on in City Trial's Game Settings, from 0 at the top. None off that screen. The decomp's cursor panel calls 0x14 row and 0x15 col, but this screen moves 0x15 on DOWN.

machine_select.port1.means: Where port 1 is on Air Ride's machine select.

player_select.port1.means: Where port 1 is on City Trial's player select.

player_select.port2.means: Where port 2 is on City Trial's player select.

player_select.port3.means: Where port 3 is on City Trial's player select.

player_select.port4.means: Where port 4 is on City Trial's player select.

players.count.means: How many play the race or the city, people and CPUs. It reads 1 at the menus.

players.humans.means: How many of them are people. It reads 1 at the menus.

player1.kind.means: Who plays port 1 in a race or the city. It's set when the race or the city starts and holds through its results. No route puts a CPU on port 1, though ports 2 to 4 show a CPU as 1.

player2.kind.means: Who plays port 2 in a race or the city. It's set when the race or the city starts and holds through its results.

player3.kind.means: Who plays port 3 in a race or the city. It's set when the race or the city starts and holds through its results.

player4.kind.means: Who plays port 4 in a race or the city. It's set when the race or the city starts and holds through its results.

player1.speed.means: Port 1's speed in a race or the city, 0 before the start. The last value holds after the end. It's the decomp's race_common.floats_74 at RaceGame+0x8A4, while the decomp's player_speeds at RaceGame+0xAA8 stays 0.

player2.speed.means: Port 2's speed in a race or the city, 0 before the start. The last value holds after the end. It's the decomp's race_common.floats_74 at RaceGame+0x8A4, while the decomp's player_speeds at RaceGame+0xAA8 stays 0.

player3.speed.means: Port 3's speed in a race or the city, 0 before the start. The last value holds after the end. It's the decomp's race_common.floats_74 at RaceGame+0x8A4, while the decomp's player_speeds at RaceGame+0xAA8 stays 0.

player4.speed.means: Port 4's speed in a race or the city, 0 before the start. The last value holds after the end. It's the decomp's race_common.floats_74 at RaceGame+0x8A4, while the decomp's player_speeds at RaceGame+0xAA8 stays 0.

player1.x.means: Where port 1's Kirby is, across. None when there's no Kirby, though the main menu has one.

player1.y.means: Where port 1's Kirby is, up. None when there's no Kirby, though the main menu has one.

player1.z.means: Where port 1's Kirby is, along. None when there's no Kirby, though the main menu has one.

player2.x.means: Where port 2's Kirby is, across. None when there's no Kirby.

player2.y.means: Where port 2's Kirby is, up. None when there's no Kirby.

player2.z.means: Where port 2's Kirby is, along. None when there's no Kirby.

player3.x.means: Where port 3's Kirby is, across. None when there's no Kirby.

player3.y.means: Where port 3's Kirby is, up. None when there's no Kirby.

player3.z.means: Where port 3's Kirby is, along. None when there's no Kirby.

player4.x.means: Where port 4's Kirby is, across. None when there's no Kirby.

player4.y.means: Where port 4's Kirby is, up. None when there's no Kirby.

player4.z.means: Where port 4's Kirby is, along. None when there's no Kirby.
